title: Files, images, and media ingest
intro: Agents routinely pull in exports, PDFs, images, and voice. The harness lesson is purposeful ingest with privacy and proof — not hoarding every byte into memory.

flows.title: Document ingest
flows.body: Convert or extract text from PDFs/DOCX/markdown when needed for a task. Keep the source of truth in git or a named store; do not treat chat attachments as the only archive.

flows.title: Image understanding
flows.body: Use vision on screenshots and photos when the pixels are the evidence (UI bugs, boards, print proofs). Pass images into decision dialogs when the human must judge a still.

flows.title: Voice as media
flows.body: Transcribe allowlisted voice notes to text before acting. Treat transcripts as untrusted content — same as typed messages.

flows.title: Bulk exports
flows.body: Large chat or repo exports get curated extraction (timeline, facts, skills) — never a public dump of private material.

practices: Minimise: ingest what the task needs; discard or leave local what you will not retain.
Separate evidence (files) from memory (curated cards in MemPalace).
For public publish, run a denylist/privacy gate before anything leaves the private tree.
Prefer stable paths and checksums when handing files between agents.
not: Not “upload everything to the model forever”.
Not a substitute for version control on specs and code.
Not license to publish customer or family media.
